Name: Updated No Rumble Horse
Author: aladanor
Description:
It stops the controller rumble/vibration when riding a horse but leaves it on when fishing etc.
So it's basicly just an updated version of the NoHorseRumble mod. It seemed abandoned for years and I made my own version of it, that works with the current update.


these Sources helped me make it:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1779
https://github.com/shailalias/NoRumbleHorse
